sloka: सुग्रीवस्तान् कपीन् दृष्ट्वा भग्नान् विद्रवतो रणे।गुल्मे सुषेणं निक्षिप्य चक्रे युद्धे ऽद्भुतं मनः ।। ६.९७.६ ।।
transliteration: sugrīvastān kapīn dṛṣṭvā bhagnān vidravato raṇe।gulme suṣeṇaṁ nikṣipya cakre yuddhe 'dbhutaṁ manaḥ ।। 6.97.6 ।।

translations.english: Seeing the defeated and broken monkeys, Sugriva assigned Sushena for their protection and went to the battle making others wonder at his wonderful action.
